title: Supply-chain controls of an example image pipeline

component.title: Example image pipeline
component.description: A CI pipeline that builds, scans, signs and attests container images.

requirements.description: Every image gets a CycloneDX SBOM generated from the image content and attached to its digest as a signed attestation before the release.
After signing, the pipeline verifies the signature against the signing key and checks that every promised tag carries the built digest.
